notes:
CRUNCH NOTES: Mid-market analytics SaaS (product analytics SDK + help center) evaluating Redwood. Started with Hosted API POC (6w) to validate RAG + chat flows. Outcome: quality acceptable, bursts cause latency spikes; cost at scale looks better with Dedicated but need committed pricing math. Customer priority: predictable latency and data isolation (can't send PII to shared pools).

Requirements summary (from product + infra):
- Workloads: user-facing support chat + background doc-search (reranking + embeddings) + daily summarization jobs.
- Latency targets: interactive P95 <= 300ms for short chats (~128 tokens); tail latency critical during morning ramp.
- Throughput: baseline 20-40 qps for chat, peak 150 qps during release windows; batching OK for embeddings jobs.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate-high; finance wants clear committed vs. burst unit economics.
- Model preferences: open LLM (Llama-family) or Redwood-verified smaller quantized models for cost tier; may require custom fine-tune later.
- Deployment: Dedicated VPC preferred for data separation; key management via customer KMS/HSM is a must.

Procurement / Legal asks we are tracking:
- MSA redlines: limit indemnity, narrow data processor obligations, add explicit SLA latency SLOs and service credit matrix, termination for convenience terms (60-90d).
- DPA: retention windows (min 90d), subprocessors list & notification, right to audit (SOC2 report + penetration test results).
- SLA: uptime 99.9% baseline, plus documented latency SLOs (P95 thresholds) and credits tied to latency breaches during business hours.
- Vendor onboarding: completed security questionnaire (attached), proof of SOC2 Type II, cyber insurance certificate (min $5M), export compliance attestation, standard SOC/pen test artifacts.
- Tech ops: need runbook for failover — automatic fallback to smaller model variant + region failover policy.

Quotes / call snippets:
- "We can't risk outage during launch — need explicit fallback + runbook."
- "If legal won't accept standard MSA edits we may need exec escalation."

Current risk profile: Legal + Security are primary blockers; pricing math acceptable if Dedicated committed discount >= 25% over Hosted at expected token volumes.
